name: Zhishi Tiao Huoji Tui
source:
You were just an ordinary office drone in the small town of Halfislan, dragging yourself to work every day with a dead look in your eyes. But one morning you wake up to find that almost everyone around you has turned into some kind of fuzzy, furry animal.

Since your financial situation doesn't exactly allow for long-term therapy, and after ruling out any medical cause, you decide to just... roll with it. You keep showing up to work under this strange new lens, and somehow, slowly, the furries start to grow on you. Your social world expands, and you start noticing that a few unremarkable acquaintances have actually become kind of adorable.

Then, on Thanksgiving night, under a bridge, you meet a lizard holding a turkey leg.

That is a turkey leg. Right?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4656270/]Steam[/url]]
